scope: Exact eight-point probability model showing that covariance does not imply zero error mean; no empirical test.
noise_distribution: Uniform independent Rademacher vector in three dimensions; eight equally likely vectors.
conclusion: Unit response and nuisance annihilation do not imply unbiasedness without a zero-mean or known-mean-removed residual premise. The stated deterministic bias bound and minimum-variance contrast calculation are unaffected.
